name: Fuuga Himeno
source:
A senpai who does everything in her power to be admired… Yes, she’s a senpai.

She carries herself with the airs of a princess yet struggles with social interactions. That said, her proportions are certainly impressive—if you conveniently ignore her height.

Her complex personality makes her stand out in all the wrong ways, often leaving her isolated. Despite this, she managed to form friendships through online gaming, though one of those bonds eventually took on a sibling-like dynamic rather than one of admiration.

Determined to prove her worth, she tries her best to impress her friends in-game… but, unfortunately, she’s not exactly skilled at it.
